evidences.evidence_quote: Previous research has explored various approaches of using Moiré patterns’ amplification characteristics to detect displacement at sub-millimeter levels [25, 36, 43], offering an alternative to traditional sensors like the fiber optic displacement sensor (FODS) [5, 40] and the laser displacement sensor (LDS) [8, 27]. ... Successful attempts have also been made to employ Moiré patterns for tracking camera and object positions [7, 37], as well as advancing to pose estimation [21, 24, 32, 33].
